name: Mukhya Mantri Kanyadaan Yojana
benefit:
1. Financial assistance for the marriage of daughters.
• 2. Reducing the financial burden on families during marriage.
• 3. Promoting gender equality.
• 4. Helping families from underprivileged backgrounds celebrate the marriage of their daughters with dignity and joy.
eligibility_rules: Daughters of families below the poverty line.
Families with an annual income of less than Rs. 35,000
documents_required: Proof of Age (Men and Women) Bonafide Himachali
CertificateProof of Annual Family Income of the applicantProof of the Date of MarriageBPL Certificate
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Go to the official website https://edistrict.hp.gov.in/pages/services/designForm/InfoPages/CM_Bestowing_Plan_(Mukhya_Mantri_Kanyadaan_Yojana).xhtmlFill the application and click on Submit ButtonYou will be redirected to the payment windowPay the application fees ( If applicable) Download the confirmation receipt.
